bio: Perched in a fantastic high-altitude location, Haller's Geniesserhotel boasts lovely, comfortable guestrooms and a spacious spa, as well as this appealing fine dining restaurant with a welcoming Alpine atmosphere. At lunchtime, a selection of sophisticated à la carte dishes is on offer; in the evening, diners take their pick from the set menu. The tempting options range from classics like Wiener schnitzel to creations such as tail of rump, celeriac two ways, curd cheese and amaranth pastry pockets. The wine list with a focus on Austria is also enticing. And don't miss out on the terrace with its magnificent mountain view!...
